config.primary_endpoint: Terminal and time-averaged clean vector-response MSE, nine fixed queries averaged within trajectory
config.secondary_endpoint: Terminal 95% clean scalar-response interval score, nine queries and three components averaged within trajectory
config.point_policy: Stage1 validation-selected practical policy; no oracle enters any uncertainty control
config.temperature_selection: Terminal clean interval score on validation; reporting q_(A/T) preserves raw recursion and mode; true geometry required for validation score only
config.process_selection: Mean pre-correction negative log predictive observation density on validation; true sensor variance and full Gaussian constants retained
config.scopes: Stationary plane separately; equally weighted large/small/one-axis force conditions share one curved policy; resistance stress never tunes
config.nominal_motion: Identity or exact same G_t from the Stage1 causal velocity predictor, available through t-1; no process method learns its own favourable rotation
config.kernel: Exact conditional first moment; inverse-moment fit projects predictive density approximately into Bingham family
config.gaussian: Two normal-line rotation coordinates, Joseph update and coordinate transport; kernel-matched E(theta^2)/2; local approximation, not exact transition density
config.shrinkage: Continuous rho in [0,1] minimizes pooled validation clean MSE for rho*mode separately for each selected method
config.statistics: Trajectory-level paired Student intervals; queries/components/times are not replicates; all contrasts exploratory except predeclared small-sphere terminal process versus Gaussian MSE
config.timings: Prediction includes inverse fit; reporting includes means/regions/intervals. Shared causal-forecast tracker cost is counted once per process/Gaussian method; never add nested timers twice.
